verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Solid components compile to real DOM nodes and can be authored as web components or via custom renderers (solid-gh-5, solid-gh-6, solid-gh-7, solid-gh-8), which implies feasibility of mounting Solid islands into existing markup, but there is no explicit documentation or example of dropping Solid into an existing server-rendered HTML page without a full app rewrite. missing for 10: explicit mount/render-into-existing-DOM example, progressive-enhancement/islands walkthrough, independent hands-on report of partial adoption in a legacy page.
